subject: Sweave to LaTex to PDF with rApache

messages.author: 4b78c958d422dcfc
messages.subject: Sweave to LaTex to PDF with rApache
parts:
I understand the premise of rApache is to be somewhat of an
alternative to Sweave and LaTex, but I am trying to setup a web app
that works with existing code that I have developed.

I would like to have a user upload a file, have rApache run a sweave
script with the uploaded data, use LaTex to convert that sweave script
to PDF and deliver that PDF to the user. Any ideas?

Thanks,
Markus

messages.author: 42eed4e1caba0ad0
messages.subject: Re: Sweave to LaTex to PDF with rApache
parts:
Ad 1. - perhaps you meant brew is an alternative to Sweave. Well... brew is templating convention for R. It works on textual files, so it's more flexible than Sweave. Sweave, OTOH, has many advantages over brew - it can handle many things in the background (graphs, command input, etc.)

Ad 2. - let's assume that you've already prepared Sweave file, and you only want to grab stuff from your data and process Sweave file - piece of cake:

Sweave("input_file.Rnw")
tools::texi2dvi("input_file.tex", pdf = TRUE)

Voila!

Of course, you need to take care about background stuff... this is only a sweave webapp in a nutshell! =)

messages.author: 4b78c958d422dcfc
messages.subject: Re: Sweave to LaTex to PDF with rApache
parts:
Quick question on that tutorial.

The tutorial says "Apache and rApache must be configured to use the
SweaveHandler function. The following are the contents of /etc/apache2/
mods-available/rapache.conf:"

<IfModule mod_R.c>
ROutputErrors
RSourceOnStartup "/path/to/SweaveHandler.R"
<FilesMatch "\.Rnw$">
SetHandler r-script
Rhandler SweaveHandler
</FilesMatch>
</IfModule>

If I have a separate rApache configuration file that I am using, can I
simply insert this code into that file?

Would I still need the <IfModule mod_R.c> tag? What does that tag
do? Also, I thought it was mod_R.so; is mod_R.c a different module?

Thanks for helping me through this.
--Markus
